title: Detection of immunoglobulin (Ig) A antibodies against porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV) in fecal and serum samples
author: Gerber, Opriessnig

steps.title: Process fecal samples
steps.instruction: Dilute fresh fecal samples and controls 1:10 w/v (0.1 g feces in 0.9 ml assay diluent), vortex for 30 s, centrifuge at 4000 × g for 10 min, and keep the clarified supernatant.

steps.title: Process serum samples
steps.instruction: Dilute serum samples and controls 1:100 (3 μl serum in 300 μl assay diluent) and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate fecal samples (primary)
steps.instruction: Add the clarified diluted fecal sample to each ELISA well, incubate at 4 °C for 16–18 h, then wash the plate 3 times with washing buffer.

steps.title: Incubate serum samples (primary)
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl of diluted serum or control to each well, incubate at 37 °C for 1 h (controls in duplicate), then wash the plate 3 times with washing buffer.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Dilute goat anti‑swine IgA HRP‑conjugated antibody (Bethyl) 1:5000 in assay diluent.

steps.title: Add secondary antibody and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl of the diluted secondary antibody to each well, incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, then wash the plate 3 times with washing buffer.

steps.title: Add TMB substrate and develop
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl SureBlue™ TMB Microwell Peroxidase Substrate (KPL) to each well, incubate at 22 °C for 20 min in the dark.

steps.title: Stop reaction and read absorbance
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl of 2 M H₂SO₄ to each well to stop the reaction, then measure absorbance at 450 nm using an ELx808 microplate reader (BioTek).
